releaseTitle: XECEAY v1.1.8 — In-App Video Player, Online Audio Fix, Direct Updates & Removed Lyrics
changelog: Restored debug keystore signature matching installed app for smooth 1-tap updates without 'App not installed' error. Added dedicated In-App Video Player to watch local & streaming MP4/YouTube videos, fixed online streaming playback redirect errors, removed lyrics display as requested, and resolved link downloader URL verification.
